set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM build/dependency integration. Current native HEAD 887a5ce4a88e3f219dad99bce46aaf6853126d1d has surface-view code requiring Intaglio ScalarMappingError, LegendTitle and related public contracts, but build.sbt pins Intaglio 2c8fd210376ee05098daeecc5bf675d126233187. Ordinary sbt surfaceViewJavafxJVM/testOnly fails with 55 errors in pre-existing shared surface code before reaching the new atlas implementation.

Prior native surface qualification docs/benchmarks/receipts/surface-map-final-2026-09-08.json identifies Intaglio 55658abfbbfed0c9a36ab612b38bd8f0677bc158. An immutable git-archive of that exact available commit supplied via scalafim.intaglio.build resolves the failure: current surfaceViewJavafxJVM/test (32), surfaceViewJVM/test (128) and surfaceViewJS/test (128) pass. Evidence /private/tmp/scalafim-affine-21/{unit.log,intaglio-source.json,qualified-tests-2.log}; retained consumer evidence will be output/brain-display/affine-21.

Acceptance: choose and qualify a coherent immutable Intaglio revision containing the required public APIs; update the native build pin with exact provenance, then pass ordinary required surface conformance and relevant direct consumers without a sibling override. Preserve unrelated scientific/provider pins and current general contracts. A successful override run is evidence of the dependency mismatch, not ordinary clean-checkout qualification. Existing atlas issue bd-01M241Y5FPND8TPHTJQVHJWW7K remains independent implementation work; consumer PLS Neuro keeps its bounded older provider contract until separately qualified adoption.
set.title: Restore a coherent Intaglio pin for the current surface-view APIs
